status: Architectural reconstruction registered to the municipal record; details photo-guided, not a survey-exact digital twin

geometry.source: City of Helsinki building register + LOD2 3D model, RATU 1691 (Pormestarinrinne 1 / Kanavakatu 1)
geometry.adaptation: Footprint outline, orientation, apse/bell-tower positions and the height envelope retained; walls, windows, cupolas and roofs authored procedurally.

facts.fact: Architect Aleksey Gornostayev; built 1862-1868; consecrated 25 Oct 1868; bricks from Bomarsund
Central cupola 33 m (interior); gilding renewed 2004-2007; on the highest hill of Katajanokka
13 gilded cupolas; five-storey bell tower whose top was rebuilt in brick c. 20 years after completion
facts.note: travel summaries; apportionment of the 13 cupolas is interpreted
